properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.rest.builtin-api-key.password-plain
properties.description: Optional. The plain-text key for ecuacion-splib's built-in API key authentication. Exactly one of this and 'jp.ecuacion.splib.rest.builtin-api-key.password-bcrypt' must be set; if neither is set, the built-in API key tier is disabled (fails closed).

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.rest.builtin-api-key.password-bcrypt
properties.description: Optional. A bcrypt hash of the key for ecuacion-splib's built-in API key authentication. Exactly one of this and 'jp.ecuacion.splib.rest.builtin-api-key.password-plain' must be set; if neither is set, the built-in API key tier is disabled (fails closed).
